# ResumeBench
**Type:** Measurement  
**Referenced in:** 1 paper  

## State of the Field

A multilingual benchmark comprising 2,500 synthetic resumes across 50 templates and 5 languages, designed to evaluate LLMs on structured resume parsing with realism and privacy compliance.

## Sources

**[Beyond Human Labels: A Multi-Linguistic Auto-Generated Benchmark for Evaluating Large Language Models on Resume Parsing](https://aclanthology.org/2025.emnlp-main.1626.pdf)**
